main-only workflow_dispatch and exact D1-01 confirmation token

followUpReview.scope: Follow-up source audit on PR #2164 branch gpt/w01-payload-3.94.1-upgrade. Re-reviewed .github/workflows/neon-w01-payload-postgres-runtime-rehearsal.yml after adding an explicit pnpm clean --lockfile step before secure lockfile regeneration. This removes stale, newly published Wrangler 4.167.0 resolutions rejected by the existing 24-hour minimumReleaseAge policy, then resolves the supported Wrangler 4.166.0 line, which satisfies OpenNext 1.20.18's ^4.148.0 peer requirement and is outside the release-age window. Confirmed the workflow still runs only against disposable PostgreSQL 18 with no remote Neon credentials, no production DDL path, and no change to the manual-only remote apply gate.
followUpReview.limitations: GPT-6 source audit and exact Git blob reconciliation only; not a human GitHub approval or independent third-party review. The updated W01 PR must pass current-head lockfile, typecheck, build, schema and PostgreSQL 18 rehearsals. No remote Neon DDL, business-data import, Worker deployment, or production cutover was performed.
